title: God Dwelling With His People
definition: God dwelling with His people is the final hope that the Lord will live among His redeemed people forever in perfect fellowship.
summary: The Bible's story moves toward restored fellowship with God. Sin separated humanity, but redemption brings God's people near forever.
christFocus: Through Christ, sinners are reconciled to God and will dwell with Him in glory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Bible's story moves toward restored fellowship with God. Sin separated humanity, but redemption brings God's people near forever.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
